summary: Faz A Design Studio full-stack verification. Backend pytest 13/13 pass (1 skipped for unrelated subscription-packages endpoint): admin design-rights-packages CRUD (list/create/update/delete + 401 without auth + 404 on missing id), 4 seeded packages (1/149, 3/399, 5/599, 10/999) verified by name/rights/price, studio /rights-packages returns active+design_rights (studio auth required), PayTR link creation returns https link + callback_id (link starts with https://www.paytr.com/link/...), status returns 'pending' for own order and 404 for foreign callback_id, invalid package_id -> 400. ONE real Gemini Nano Banana ai-edit call succeeded: studio1 design_rights 10->9, revised image served via /api/design/asset/{id} returns 200 image/png >1KB. Foreign asset_id -> 404, bogus asset_id -> 404. Regression: /api/services 200, admin login 200. Frontend: admin login -> /admin/tasarim-haklari lists 4 rows (drp-row-*), drp-add creates tmp row, name filled, drp-save calls POST and shows Kaydedildi toast, drp-del confirms and removes row (Silindi toast). Studio login -> /studyo/panel -> studio-limit-design card shows 'Tasarim Hakki 9'. On /tasarim-studyosu: (a) bulk without {isim} field shows exact error toast 'Once tuvale {isim} kisisellestirme alani ekleyin' as required, (b) ds-add-personalize adds field, (c) ds-bulk-btn opens bulk-dialog, bulk-names accepts 3 names, count shows 3, bulk-generate-btn triggers ZIP download 'Isimsiz Tasarim-toplu.zip' successfully client-side, (d) ds-ai-btn -> ai-buy-btn -> ai-buy-dialog fetches 4 buy-pkg-btn-* buttons, clicking one calls POST /api/studio/payments/design-rights/create -> 200 with real PayTR link and opens new tab https://www.paytr.com/link/... (payment NOT completed as instructed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5893 lines - well past the 700-line guideline. Admin package CRUD, PayTR create helper, grant logic, seed all mixed in one module. Recommend factoring admin design-rights CRUD into /app/backend/routers/admin_design_rights.py and _create_paytr_order/_grant_paid_order into a payments helper module. Not blocking but increasingly risky.

DesignStudio.jsx openBuy() sets aiBuyOpen=true BEFORE the await api call. On slow networks the dialog briefly renders 'Paket bulunamadi.' before packages arrive (needed a ~3s wait in automated test). Consider awaiting fetch first, or showing a 'Yukleniyor...' placeholder while aiPackages is null (distinguish null from empty array).
Admin package Pydantic DesignRightsPackageIn has no upper bound on price/rights beyond ge=0/gt=0 - a stray huge value would be accepted. Consider price <= 100000 and rights <= 1000.

DELETE /api/admin/design-rights-packages/{pid} hard-deletes. Historical payment_orders may reference package_id (order_extra); prefer soft-delete via active=false or block delete when orders exist to avoid orphan reference in reports.

studio.py _set_studio_cookie issues a 1-day cookie whose absolute TTL equals the access token TTL; there is no refresh-token flow for studio accounts so a page open >24h will silently 401. Consider a longer-lived refresh token or server-side session extension.
buy_rights returns raw PayTR shape {callback_id, link, paytr_link_id}. Frontend only uses callback_id + link - paytr_link_id is exposed unnecessarily; harmless but worth trimming.
AdminDesignRights.jsx uses window.confirm() for delete which is an anti-pattern against the shadcn design system. Replace with the shadcn <AlertDialog>. Minor UX.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Faz A flows: admin CRUD, studio panel card, bulk personalize incl. no-isim error, ai-buy dialog + PayTR link + new tab)

seed_data_creation: 1 TEST_UI_Paket + 1 TEST_Paket_2 package created via UI/API respectively, both DELETED at end of their tests. AI ai-edit consumed 1 design right (10->9) on studio1 as required by the task; 1 new design_asset row (source=ai_edit) persists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Studio1 design_rights is now 9 (was 10) due to the mandatory one ai-edit call. If future tests assume 10, reset via db.studio_accounts.updateOne({email:'studio1@test.com'},{$set:{design_rights:10}}). PayTR link creations left ~2 pending orders in db.payment_orders for studio1 (kind=studio_design_rights, status=pending) - safe, will time out. Bulk personalization is client-side (JSZip) and produces 'Isimsiz Tasarim-toplu.zip' - verified via expect_download. The buy dialog fetches packages AFTER opening; playwright must wait ~2-3s after clicking ai-buy-btn before asserting on buy-pkg-btn-* count. Studio login button text is 'Panele Giris' (not just 'Giris' - that matches the tab).
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in Faz A scope.
